batch.noProvider: Configure an AI provider in Settings to process workouts.
batch.error: Batch processing encountered an unexpected error.

weekStatus.heading: Where the week stands
weekStatus.waiting_one: {{count}} waiting to go to your watch
weekStatus.waiting_other: {{count}} waiting to go to your watch

firstRun.heading: Nothing here yet — and nothing will appear on its own
firstRun.body: Kaiord doesn't hold your training. It reads it from your sources, structures it, and sends it back to your watch. Three things have to be true before this week fills itself.
firstRun.manual: Not ready to connect anything? Write a session by hand — everything else still works.

sources.title: Connect where your training comes from
sources.consequence: Train2Go for your coach's plan, Garmin for what you actually rode. Without this, the week stays empty.

aiKey.title: Add your own AI key
aiKey.consequence: A coach's note in prose becomes steps and targets. Your key, your bill, stored in this browser.

bridge.title: Install the bridge extension
bridge.consequence: Garmin has no public API for workouts, so the handover to your watch happens in your browser. Skip it and you can still download the file.

emptyWeek.headline: Nothing this week
emptyWeek.headlineWithDate: Nothing this week — your last session was {{date}}
emptyWeek.consequence: Either you're between blocks, or your coach hasn't published. Nothing is broken.

noAiProvider.headline_one: {{count}} session arrived as prose and is stuck that way
noAiProvider.headline_other: {{count}} sessions arrived as prose and are stuck that way
noAiProvider.consequence: Turning “4×8 min at threshold” into steps needs an AI key, and there isn't one. Your watch can't receive prose.

noBridges.headline_one: {{count}} session is ready but can't reach your watch
noBridges.headline_other: {{count}} sessions are ready but can't reach your watch
noBridges.consequence: Garmin has no public API for workouts, so the bridge extension does the handover. Until it's installed, downloading the file and importing it by hand is the only route.

coachMoves.moved_one: {{count}} session moved to the coach's new date.
coachMoves.moved_other: {{count}} sessions moved to the coach's new dates.
coachMoves.overridden_one: {{count}} of them replaced a day you had chosen.
coachMoves.overridden_other: {{count}} of them replaced days you had chosen.

preflight.no-export-route: Turn on sending workouts to Garmin in Connections (Workout → Also sent to), then send the week.
preflight.no-bridge: Install the Kaiord Garmin Bridge extension, then send the week.
preflight.no-session: Sign in to Garmin Connect in this browser, then send the week.
preflight.insecure-context: The Garmin calendar needs a secure (HTTPS) page. Nothing was sent.
preflight.unsupported-browser: The Garmin calendar needs a browser with Web Locks. Nothing was sent.

status.duplicate-left: On its date, extra entry left

sendWeek.outdated: Your Garmin Bridge extension can't use the calendar yet, so these reached your library only. Update it, then retry.
